Timetable to Calendar Converter

Convert school or work class timetable CSVs into recurring weekly iCal events. Zero server uploads — all processing happens directly in your browser.

What it does

Converts class schedules, university lectures, and work shift timetables from simple CSV spreadsheets into recurring weekly iCal (.ics) calendar events. Generates RFC 5545 compliant recurring VEVENT entries with proper time zone formatting and recurrence rules.

How to use

  1. Create a CSV with columns: day, start, end, title (e.g., Monday, 09:00, 10:30, Mathematics Lecture).
  2. Upload the CSV schedule file into the timetable converter interface.
  3. Review the number of recurring calendar events generated by the parser.
  4. Download timetable.ics and import it directly into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.

Limits & Considerations

Generates recurring weekly events for a standard 16-week term. Custom bi-weekly alternating schedules require separate CSV exports.

Privacy & Security

Student schedules and employee shift CSVs are parsed locally in browser memory with zero cloud transmission.
